title: Best Pool Route Software 2026: Optimization Plans & Prices
description: Pool route software compared: which plan of Skimmer, UpBuoy, Pool Brain, POM and GorillaDesk includes route optimization, and what it costs per tech.
h1: Best pool route software: who includes route optimization, and for how much
body:
A pool route is the same weekly stops in the same order, plus last-minute moves when a customer cancels, a tech calls out or a green pool needs a return visit. Route software should do three things: build the route, reorder it to cut drive time, and let you move a stop without rebuilding the week. Below is what five pool tools (plus Jobber and Housecall Pro) publish about routing, and what it costs to get route optimization, not just a route list. All prices come from vendor pages checked 2026-11-09; anything not published is marked unknown. For calendar and dispatch views, see pool service scheduling software; for the full feature picture, see best pool service software and the pool service hub.

1. Skimmer: optimization on Scaling Up, billed per pool

Getting Started ($1 per serviced location, starts at $49/mo) includes Route Builder, so you can lay out routes, but Route Optimization, the Schedule and Recurring Work Orders are on Scaling Up ($2 per serviced location, starts at $98/mo). Both plans include unlimited technicians and admins, and a location you don't service in a month isn't billed. Skimmer's page also offers the first month of Scaling Up free for new users (promo terms on its page) and a 30-day refund guarantee (Skimmer pricing). Details: Skimmer pricing explained. {{aff:skimmer|See Skimmer plans}}

2. UpBuoy: free plan for up to 3 pools, optimization on Professional

UpBuoy's Essential plan is free for up to 3 locations and includes the technician app and basic scheduling and routing. Professional is $3 per serviced location per month with a $99 minimum and adds route optimization, a visual schedule calendar, work orders, a customer portal and API access. A location is any unique address you work at during the month; repeat visits count once. Paid plans have a 30-day money-back guarantee and no long-term contract (UpBuoy pricing). Its homepage also lists an LSI calculator with dosing and two-way QuickBooks sync. See UpBuoy pricing and features. {{aff:upbuoy|Visit UpBuoy}}

3. Pool Brain: one-click optimization and a route profit report

Pool Brain has one plan with every feature: $50/mo base (unlimited office users) plus $65/mo per active field technician; its calculator starts at 5 techs ($375/mo). Its features page lists one-click route optimization, drag-and-drop for any stop, one-time moves, real-time progress indicators, an Unscheduled section, and a route profit report that flags customers you're making low profit or losing money on. The app is described as working with no cell signal and syncing later (Pool Brain features, pricing). See Pool Brain. {{aff:poolbrain|Visit Pool Brain}}

4. Pool Office Manager: map view and route optimization on every account

Pool Office Manager (POM) includes route optimization in its single plan, alongside Timeline, Map, Combined and Calendar schedule views, drag-and-drop assignment, recurring appointments and an Unassigned queue. It's $125/mo for the first user and $25/mo per additional active user, month to month, with no per-route or per-customer charges; users can be deactivated in the off-season. There's a 30-day free trial (card entered at signup) (POM pricing). See Pool Office Manager. {{aff:poolofficemanager|Visit Pool Office Manager}}

5. GorillaDesk: priced per route, with a 25-stop cap on Basic

GorillaDesk charges per route (one schedule per tech who drives solo; crews riding together share one) with unlimited users. Basic ($49/mo) includes job mapping and basic routing limited to 25 stops at a time, which is short for a full pool day. Pro ($99/mo) adds Drive Matrix routing with real-time street routing and drive times; Growth ($149/mo) adds drive-time display, Best Available Time and Job Magnet for pulling nearby jobs together. 14-day free trial, no card, no contracts (GorillaDesk pricing). Full breakdown: GorillaDesk pricing. {{aff:gorilladesk|Visit GorillaDesk}}

6 and 7. Jobber and Housecall Pro: general field service routing

Neither is pool-specific. Jobber puts routing (route optimization) and GPS tracking on Connect and up, not Core. Housecall Pro lists routes on Essentials and one-click route optimization on MAX. See Jobber pricing, Housecall Pro pricing and Jobber vs Housecall Pro.

The pattern: per-pool pricing (Skimmer, UpBuoy) is cheapest when you have few pools per tech, and per-tech or per-user pricing (Pool Brain, POM, GorillaDesk) gets relatively cheaper as each tech's route grows. Plug in your own pool count before deciding. More cost math: pool service software cost.

How to choose pool route software

  • Count pools per tech. Divide the per-tech or per-route price by your pools per route and compare it with Skimmer's $2 or UpBuoy's $3 per pool.
  • Check the stop cap. GorillaDesk Basic routes 25 stops at a time; a full pool day can be longer.
  • Check where optimization lives. Skimmer, UpBuoy, Jobber and Housecall Pro put it on a higher plan than their entry tier.
  • Plan for the off-season. Skimmer and UpBuoy don't bill unserviced locations; POM lets you deactivate users; GorillaDesk lets you freeze the account.
  • Test with your real route. Use the trial or free plan with one week of real stops. Our software buying checklist lists what to test.

faq: What is the best pool route software?

It depends on how you bill and grow. Skimmer (Scaling Up, $2 per serviced pool) and UpBuoy (Professional, $3 per serviced location, $99 minimum) charge per pool; Pool Brain ($50 base + $65 per field tech) and Pool Office Manager ($125 first user + $25 per extra user) include route optimization on their only plan; GorillaDesk charges per route and adds Drive Matrix routing on Pro ($99/mo). Prices from vendor pages checked 2026-11-09.
Which pool software has route optimization?

Skimmer (Scaling Up), UpBuoy (Professional), Pool Brain (all accounts), Pool Office Manager (all accounts), GorillaDesk (Drive Matrix on Pro), Jobber (Connect and up) and Housecall Pro (MAX) list route optimization on their pricing or features pages.
Is there free pool route software?

UpBuoy's Essential plan is free for up to 3 locations and includes basic scheduling and routing, but route optimization requires the paid Professional plan. None of the other pool tools here publish a free plan.
How much does pool route optimization software cost for a solo tech?

For 1 tech with 60 pools at list prices: GorillaDesk Pro $99/mo, Pool Brain $115/mo by its formula, Skimmer Scaling Up $120/mo, Pool Office Manager $125/mo, UpBuoy Professional $180/mo. Add-ons, texting and card fees are extra.
Yes. GorillaDesk's pricing page says Basic routing is limited to 25 stops at a time. Pro adds Drive Matrix routing with real-time street routing and drive times.
